2. The Ledger and Habits held, at the close of each week
3. Habits formed: share of games holding each, per week
4. Events cancelled per week, by how (two are drawn each week from week 2)
5. How the five days are played, per week
6. Habitus moves per week: Hero, Dependable and Recognition
Dependable: Take One For The Team
7. Team Score distribution: number of games per score
at or above the high threshold
8. Team Reflexivity: share of games with each well filled, evidence on offer, and the Habit held
9. Motivation: characters at each level at the close of each week, and quits that week
10. Motivation per week: lowest, mean, median, and quits (goal in optimal play: 0 quits)
11. Who quits when: average quits a game, by habitus card and week
12. Cards played: average per game, by week
